declared difference (truth fix T1, code view): the awk read block comments and string literals as code, so a
commented-out changed(Property q ...) was taken as the callback and the real one was never read (T), the "}" in a
string could end changed() early, and a setter quoted in a string counted as a write (U). Both hot-write lints read
code with comments blanked and literal contents removed now.
(Tree values made fresh, setX(N) -> setX(getX() + N), after truth fix T5: a constant written to a simple
slot is not a per-cycle write; the rows are unchanged.)

@DIR@

exit 0
